subject: Invoice gateway & PO alignment — bookings recognition timelines
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO and invoice timing for Q4 bookings

Ben / Karthik / team —

Thanks for the demo last week. Acme is ready to move forward with the Enterprise plan for the AI search pilot. Procurement needs to align on PO timing and the invoice path to ensure our bookings recognize in Q4. A few specifics we need confirmed from Redwood before issuing the PO: 

- Can invoices be routed to invoices@acme.com with the PO number on the invoice header?
- Is there a standard invoice template (we prefer PDF) and will the invoice show the Redwood legal entity line-item we reviewed?
- We have a cutover date request of 2026-12-10 — if the PO is signed by 2026-12-03, can Redwood confirm invoicing and revenue recognition windows?

I attached the initial PO draft (ACME_PO_12345.pdf). Procurement would appreciate a short note confirming invoice routing, the earliest invoice date, and any documentation we should include on the PO to avoid delays.

Jordan
Jordan Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
Attachment: ACME_PO_12345.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO and invoice timing for Q4 bookings

Jordan —

Thanks for sending the draft. Quick answers up front: yes, we can route invoices to invoices@acme.com and include the PO number on the invoice header. We will use our standard PDF invoice (I attached the latest template) and the legal entity line will read "Redwood Inference, Inc." with our tax ID.

About timing — two important notes for bookings recognition: 

1) Invoice issuance vs. recognition: Our finance team recognizes bookings when an invoice is issued and accepted per the SOW terms, or once payment terms are satisfied for committed orders. If you need recognition in Q4, we should have the PO signed and the invoice issued no later than 2026-12-10 (same-day issuance works).

2) Cutover operational tasks: For SaaS cutovers we require the onboarding checklist completed (SOW signoff, account provisioning, and acceptance criteria). To ensure the December 10 recognition, please confirm provisioning tasks are on track — I can loop in Customer Success to speed any gaps.

I asked Marissa (cc) to confirm whether any additional invoice language is required on the PO to avoid processing delays on your side.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-invoice-template-v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO and invoice timing for Q4 bookings

Hi Jordan —

Quick finance note to make sure there are no surprises on our end: 

- Please include the PO number in the "Invoice Reference" field and put "Redwood Inference, Inc., EIN: 12-3456789" on the billing address block. That prevents accounting from placing invoices on hold for missing entity info.
- Net 30 is fine unless you request Net 15; please state payment terms on the PO.
- If Acme requires invoice submission through a vendor portal (e.g., Ariba), please provide the URL and contact. We can submit via portal but that can add 3–5 business days to processing — it may push recognition past 12/10 if the PO is only signed at the wire date.

If the PO is signed by 12/03 and you ask us to issue an invoice the same day, we will prioritize it. If you need guaranteed recognition in Q4, please try to target PO sign by 12/01 so we have buffer for portal processing or approvals.

I'll record this as a ticket and follow up once the final PO is received.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO and invoice timing for Q4 bookings

Thanks Marissa / Ben — appreciate the clarity. Procurement confirmed they will route the PO to you by 2026-12-01 EOD with the Invoice Reference and Redwood EIN included. We do need submission through our Coupa portal (URL below) — portal submission is mandatory for our AP team. Please confirm once you've submitted and whether you expect the portal to add processing days.

Coupa vendor portal: https://acme.coupavendor.com/submit

If there are any showstoppers, we will flag earlier this week. Otherwise expect the PO by 12/01 and target invoice issuance same day.

Jordan
